text: I was furious with him, and told him that Juliet had been dead for hundreds of years and that her body was lying in a marble tomb in Verona. I think, from his blank look of amazement, that he was under the impression that I had taken too much champagne, or something.” “I am not surprised.” “Then he asked me if I wrote for any of the newspapers. I told him I never even read them. He seemed terribly disappointed at that, and confided to me that all the dramatic critics were in a conspiracy against him, and that they were every one of them to be bought.” “I should not wonder if he was quite right there. But, on the other hand, judging from their appearance, most of them cannot be at all expensive.” “Well, he seemed to think they were beyond his means,” laughed Dorian.
